text:
alex: quick sync — we need a single source-of-truth for error metrics that feed the new reliability dashboards. timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, and degraded/fallback counts need concrete defs + tags. who owns the schema?

nina: I can take dashboard UX/requirements. We want per-route and per-model breakdowns, plus a single-pane error taxonomy view for oncall. UX notes: keep cardinality low on the default view, allow drilling into high-card metrics.

jess: for runtime/infra inputs, we need clarity on what each layer emits. my proposal: runtime emits `redwood.runtime.request_*` (latency, status, error_type, fallback_used boolean), infra emits `redwood.node.memory_oom` and `redwood.node.eviction` and the ingest layer emits `redwood.gateway.5xx_*` with upstream tag.

carlos: +1 but watch label explosion. We should normalize `error_type` with a small enum: `timeout`, `5xx`, `oom`, `fallback`, `validation_error`. Keep `model` tag optional and sampled for high-cardinality models only.

kai: from SRE side — define a canonical timeout metric: `redwood.runtime.request_timeout_total` (counter) and `redwood.runtime.request_timeout_seconds_bucket` for histo. We need the counter for SLO burn calculations. Also note we should have a `degraded_mode_activation` counter when runtime returns cached/fallback responses.

alex: concrete suggestion for tags: `service=runtime|gateway`, `deployment_mode=hosted|dedicated|private`, `region`, `route`, `model_name` (optional), `tier=prod|staging`. Thoughts?

jess: fine but add `fallback_reason` for degraded responses: `cache_hit`, `model_fallback`, `reduced_decoding`. That can stay empty for non-fallbacks.

carlos: we need retention guidance. Metrics with `model_name` tag should be high-cardinality; propose sampling to 1% by default for model-level breakdowns, configurable per-customer.

ingest-bot: reminder: metric names must follow snake_case and prefix with `redwood.`. Please file schema PR in infra/telemetry repo.

nina: dashboard panels: 1) error taxonomy heatmap (error_type x route) 2) SLO burn (30m/24h) 3) OOMs timeline by node group 4) fallbacks over time with stack-trace-lite link to logs 5) top-10 routes by error rate. Default time range 6h, auto-refresh 30s.

kai: add alerting thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m for prod tier OR timeout rate spike > 50% of baseline. Also alert on `degraded_mode_activation` > X per minute (TBD).

ajex: (typo) meant alex — action items: alex -> own cross-team spec; jess -> runtime metric PR with examples and counters; carlos -> sampling + retention policy; nina -> dashboard mockups and query examples; kai -> alert thresholds and runbook snippets. Can we commit to a 2-week delivery window for the spec + PR?

jess: i'll draft PR by EOD tomorrow with example metrics and a sample ingestion mapping. snippet I'll include: 
```
# example counters
redwood_runtime_request_total{error_type="timeout",service="runtime",route="/v1/generate"} 42
redwood_runtime_request_total{error_type="fallback",fallback_reason="model_fallback",service="runtime"} 7
redwood_node_memory_oom_total{node_group="g1"} 1
```

carlos: for storage costs, also emit `redwood_runtime_error_sample` as a low-cardinality summary tag set for dashboards (counts per error_type+route only). That avoids querying raw high-cardinality metrics for default panels.

nina: dashboard query examples would prefer the summary metric. drilldown will fetch sampled model-level metrics. good separation.

kai: one more: instrument the rollout path — `redwood.rollout.fallbacks` with `canary=true|false` so console rollouts can show whether a new version increases fallbacks.

alex: perfect. i'll open a tracking ticket linking owners and timeline. also pinging @security and @product-ops for compliance/retention limits. anyone object to the enum set: timeout, 5xx, oom, fallback, validation_error?

jess: fine. add `auth_error`? we occasionally see 401/403 spikes that are legit errors.

carlos: include `auth_error` but map it to 5xx? I'd keep it separate — good to surface auth spikes.

alex: updated enum: `timeout`, `5xx`, `oom`, `fallback`, `validation_error`, `auth_error`. ok. next steps: spec PR (jess) by end of week, dashboard mocks (nina) in 3 days, alert proposals (kai) in 4 days. we’ll reconvene in #eng-platform next Wed. thanks all :thumbsup:
